rules: Flat by default: establish separation with tonal surfaces and borders before shadows.
Use NEU green for primary actions and meaningful brand emphasis, not decoration.
Light and dark themes share the same semantic hierarchy and accessible states.
Prefer direct content hierarchy and clear labels over decorative badges and repeated cards.

elevation.avoid: ambient glow and heavy stacked shadows

motion.transitions: Restrained color and state transitions; honor prefers-reduced-motion.

do: Use semantic theme tokens for surfaces, text, borders, focus, and statuses.
Keep task context and primary actions easy to scan.
Retain accessible labels when compacting navigation on mobile.
dont: Add decorative gradients, glow, or excessive blur.
Wrap every content item in a repeated card or badge.
Rely on color alone to communicate status.

button.primary: Semantic NEU green with white foreground; visible keyboard focus.

card.surface: Theme surface token with semantic border; flat at rest.

input.surface: Theme canvas token with semantic border and green focus state.
